units.invariant: A villager spawned through the direct spawn-egg offspring path receives a stable name and exactly one authoritative parent assignment only after the spawn succeeds.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN; inspect Optional<Mob> result and the parent parameter
units.supportedEventAlternative: No 1.21.1 supported event exposes both the exact interacted parent and the successfully returned child; re-check the target spawn API before replacing this hook.

units.invariant: Villagers have 18 inventory slots while wandering traders retain their vanilla inventory size.
units.injectionPoint: TAIL; replace the constructed SimpleContainer only when the instance is a Villager
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported entity-construction event can replace the private inventory field before all vanilla users observe it.

units.invariant: Profession changes and age-boundary transitions schedule exactly the derived-name refreshes that affect villager presentation and persistence.
units.injectionPoint: HEAD of setVillagerData after a profession comparison; TAIL of ageBoundaryReached
units.supportedEventAlternative: No single supported event covers both direct VillagerData mutation and the private age-boundary callback.

units.invariant: Villager pickup accepts only recognized food, emerald value, farming inputs, lumberjack saplings, and supported profession inputs while preserving the three reserved food slots.
units.injectionPoint: HEAD; cancel the return value for unrecognized or non-reservable stacks
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported pickup event runs at the same preflight decision point with the villager inventory available.

units.invariant: Villager canBreed requires adulthood, wakefulness, and the configured custom-hunger threshold.
units.injectionPoint: HEAD; replace the boolean result from the public eligibility query
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported event can change this synchronous eligibility query without changing every vanilla caller.

units.invariant: A successful villager emerald pickup credits exactly the accepted inventory delta once, including block value, without charging failed or client-side attempts.
units.injectionPoint: HEAD and TAIL; capture the pre-pickup value and credit only the post-pickup delta
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported event exposes both the villager's pre-pickup inventory value and the accepted post-pickup delta.

units.invariant: Emerald value dropped by a villager debits the linked account once for the spawned stack, including direct callers of the ItemStack-and-offset overload.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN; account the returned ItemEntity path only for server-side Villager instances
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported drop event has the required guarantee that every direct spawnAtLocation caller is observed exactly once.

units.invariant: Player-caused villager reputation loss uses accepted damage proportionally, while non-player, ineffective, cancelled, and disabled-config paths preserve their existing policy without leaking capture state.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN of setLastHurtByMob; MODIFY_ARGS at GossipContainer#add inside onReputationEventFrom
units.supportedEventAlternative: LivingDamageEvent can capture accepted damage, but no supported event rewrites only the matching GossipContainer mutation; keep the narrow gossip hook unless equivalent ordering is proven.

units.invariant: Breeding reserves a valid bed and hunger decision, suppresses vanilla food charging, cleans up interruption, and applies cooldown, family links, and hunger costs only after one successful birth.
units.injectionPoint: HEAD/RETURN hooks and one INVOKE redirect for Villager#eatAndDigestFood
units.supportedEventAlternative: BabyEntitySpawnEvent does not cover the 1.21.1 VillagerMakeLove birth path; no supported event owns the reservation transaction.

units.invariant: Core, idle, and meet goal packages contain the mod behaviors exactly once, preserve vanilla ordering, and route banker job-site work through the bank-aware behavior.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN injections plus NEW/INVOKE redirects inside getCorePackage
units.supportedEventAlternative: NeoForge 21.1.219 exposes no public goal-package construction event; preserve composition in VillagerGoalPackageIntegration and keep this adapter narrow.

units.invariant: Villager and wandering-trader path evaluation treats supported fence gates as door-like, while emerald golems retain their openable path behavior and unrelated mobs are unchanged.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN; adjust the path type after vanilla block-state evaluation
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported path-evaluation event provides the current mob and cached block state at this decision point.

units.invariant: Villagers, wandering traders, and emerald golems receive safe vertical ladder nodes without changing unrelated mob path evaluation.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN of both path-type and neighbor enumeration methods
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported event exposes WalkNodeEvaluator's current context and mutable neighbor array.

units.invariant: A villager follows the vertical direction required by its ladder path, claims one ladder column at a time, and releases the claim when traversal ends or is disabled.
units.injectionPoint: TAIL; apply climb velocity and ladder-claim lifecycle after the brain AI tick
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported event runs after this private villager AI step with access to the current path and entity movement.

units.invariant: Iron golems may hit targets within the configured vertical reach above their head without changing horizontal reach or other mob melee checks.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN; only widen a false result for IronGolem instances
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported attack event can change the synchronous range predicate before the goal consumes it.

units.invariant: Zombie door-breaking chance follows the configured difficulty rule at construction time and remains stable for the zombie's lifetime.
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported goal-construction event replaces the predicate before the zombie stores it.

units.invariant: Villager conversion follows the configured difficulty and peaceful boundary while preserving vanilla conversion side effects.
units.injectionPoint: REDIRECT of ServerLevel#getDifficulty used by the conversion branch
units.supportedEventAlternative: LivingConversionEvent.Post observes the outcome after conversion and cannot replace the pre-conversion difficulty gate.

units.invariant: Custom professions render with their intended temporary vanilla profession layer textures without changing unrelated villager layers.
units.injectionPoint: RETURN; replace only profession-folder locations present in the override map
units.supportedEventAlternative: No supported client render-layer event exposes the resolved profession texture at this point; verify the target layer API during the client port.
